svg.title: dsh-baton
svg.desc: dsh-baton lets Claude Code or Codex pass a task, like a relay baton, to a local DeepSeek Harness over an owner-only local socket. A dsh_send call returns a run id; the same session appears in Harness, runs, and completes.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "Microsoft YaHei", "PingFang SC", monospace

g.text: MCP 服务器 + HARNESS 插件
